tagline: A leading, nimble North American agriculture and renewable fuels company
hero_kpi_rationale: The Renewables segment is a key driver with record ethanol production and clean fuel tax credits, benefiting from efficient production and favorable biofuel policies.

kpis.name: Ethanol Production
kpis.explanation: Total volume of ethanol produced by the company's plants.
kpis.description: The company produced 789.2 million gallons in 2025, a record level but a slight decline compared to 2024.
kpis.signal: Record production despite a slight year-over-year decline.

kpis.name: Gross Profit Agribusiness
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenues and cost of goods sold in the Agribusiness segment.
kpis.description: Gross profit in the Agribusiness segment reached $556.9 million in 2025, an increase of 6.5% compared to 2024 ($522.992M in 2024).
kpis.signal: Margin improvement driven by exports and ethanol.

kpis.name: Gross Profit Renewables
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenues and cost of goods sold in the Renewables segment.
kpis.description: Gross profit in the Renewables segment reached $156.7 million in 2025, a decrease of 8.3% compared to 2024 ($170.934M in 2024), due to higher corn and natural gas costs.

kpis.name: Grain Storage Capacity
kpis.explanation: Total grain storage capacity owned or leased by the company.
kpis.description: Total storage capacity was 271 million bushels in 2025, down 6.9% from 291 million in 2024, due to the closure of several underperforming small facilities and an incident at a terminal in Sunray, Texas.
kpis.signal: Reduction due to closure of underperforming sites.

kpis.name: Clean Fuel Tax Credit
kpis.explanation: Amount of tax credits recognized for renewable fuel production under Section 45Z.
kpis.description: The company recognized $35 million in Section 45Z tax credits for clean fuel production in 2025, directly contributing to the Renewables segment results.

kpis.name: Corn Basis Risk
kpis.explanation: Exposure to fluctuations in corn prices, the primary input for ethanol and animal feed production.
kpis.description: Higher corn prices in the East weighed on the Renewables segment margin despite record ethanol production.
kpis.signal: Margin pressure in the Renewables segment in 2025.

kpis.name: Ethanol Shipped
kpis.explanation: Volume of ethanol shipped to customers.
kpis.description: 789.2 million gallons shipped in 2025, compared to 793.6 million in 2024.

kpis.name: DDG Shipped
kpis.explanation: Byproduct of ethanol production, used as animal feed.
kpis.description: 2.13 million tons shipped in 2025, down 13.1% from 2.45 million in 2024.

risks.title: Volatile market
risks.score_rationale: The agriculture sector is subject to price and volume fluctuations, which impact company results. The company faced challenges in 2025 due to an oversupplied market and low prices.

risks.title: Raw material dependency
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on the price and availability of raw materials, particularly corn and fertilizers. Price changes directly impact results, as seen in 2025 with high corn costs.

risks.title: Environmental risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict environmental regulations and may be held liable for non-compliance. Compliance costs can be significant.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The agriculture sector is highly competitive. The company must maintain its market share against growing competition to preserve margins.

risks.title: Litigation risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to various claims and ongoing litigation in the normal course of business, including environmental matters. Defense costs can be significant.

risks.title: Reputational damage
risks.score_rationale: Reputational damage can impact sales and margins. Risks include environmental and social issues.

risks.title: Regulatory risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations, particularly environmental ones. Non-compliance can impact finances and reputation.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies was found in ANDE's 10-K filing.
